title: Scalar-compatible rank-one integral section comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, its valuation ring A, and any scheme X. Let F be continuousScalarFunctor A followed by point inverse image, the fixed integralSectionFunctor, and restriction along integralDetailedCoefficientComparison; let G be restriction along ULift.down followed by integralConstantModule. The functors are formed from [def-sfb-integral-section-action-transport], [def-sfb-integral-completed-coefficient-transport], [def-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-models] and [lem-sfb-continuous-scalar-finite-presentation]. Their values on the single lifted regular module ULift A are isomorphic by an isomorphism e satisfying F(f) followed by e = e followed by G(f), for every A-linear endomorphism f of ULift A. No arbitrary module, finite presentation, finite free matrix or cokernel is asserted.

source.place: Definition 6.8.10 and Proposition 6.8.11(3); the regular-module scalar calculation in step 1 of lem-sfb-integral-section-scalar-models.

proof.text: Apply the scalar-endomorphism comparison to obtain an isomorphism on the lifted regular module and a commuting square for every multiplication endomorphism.

Every endomorphism of the lifted regular module is multiplication by its value on the lifted element 1. The proved ULift-linear calculation endomorphism_eq_scalar rewrites an arbitrary endomorphism as the corresponding scalar endomorphism, after which the scalar square gives the required naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem regularComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ e : (sectionRealization l E X).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) ≅
      (completedRealization l E X).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))),
      ∀ f : ModuleCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)) ⟶
        ModuleCat.of (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
          (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)),
        (sectionRealization l E X).map f ≫ e.hom =
          e.hom ≫ (completedRealization l E X).map f
